description: Two processes, both shared read/write on T(ID COUNTER key, Who TEXT 1, N LONG), insert ten rows each in four alternating rounds (A, B, A, B, ...) ordered by barriers. A then reads the row count, the distinct IDs and the rows by writer; the closed file is kept.
retentionNote: Designed r-def-cat-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
